newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs end lower in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs end lower in listless trade.

text.p: Indian global depository shares drifted lower Thursday in light trading.
Traders noted some buying in late afternoon, but said the market lacked direction.
"The market was thin and difficult with some firm undertones," one trader said.
News of a much anticipated bonus issue by Reliance failed to spark broad interest, traders said, though Reliance gained 69 cents to $22.75/$23.50.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.49 points lower at 89.07, or 0.49 percent, with the premium over the local market at 29.79 percent from 30.87 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 6.48 points to 4.088.98.
State Bank of India fell 12 cents to $26.35/$27.10 and Telco lost 12 cents to $14.50/$15.50.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed down 1.94 points, or 2.44 percent, to 77.71 points, a premium of 42.47 percent over the local market.
Korean GDRs suffered from their second straight fall, down from a peak of 82.14 on Tuesday.
Seoul's composite stock index lost 2.26 points to 770.95.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index dropped 3.97 points, or 3.11 percent, to 123.74, representing a discount to the local market of 3.34 percent.
